title: Coverage Recheck
description: coverage-recheck/v1 — a party asking the valuation engine to evaluate the report again, because collateral arrived after its deadline. The engine owns evaluation, so a party cannot change a report's status; it can state on the log that the facts have moved and let the engine look. The claim is signed and durable, which a nudge outside the platform would not be.

requestedBy.description: The organization asking. Events carry roles rather than organizations, so the document pins the organization.

reason.description: Why the engine should look again, in the requester's own words.
